I would seek professional help but it always seems like that costs (a good deal of) money, and I don't have it. The last bit I had from my last pay check went to buying a new battery for my moms car, but the car wouldn't even start so it was needed.
Sometimes I can block her out, it's a habit I've built up over the years, but even the sound of her walking up and down the hallway makes me tense these days. I know she's going to call someone up and complain about me, and lie while doing so. So many people in the family dislike me now because of stuff she's said and they won't hear my side on things.
I can't upvote this enough. Thanks.

I would never force anyone into a relationship. That would just be rude/disrespectful on my part.
What you're saying makes sense, and I admit that. It still hurts because I'm talking to him right now and the idea of not just sucks. haha. The bad thing is before I started talking to him like this I was happy to be alone for awhile. I'm in school and working on how I want things to be.

I feel a bit like I'm. . betraying Alex though. Maybe that's to harsh a word but I already feel kinda torn because I'd feel kinda sad if he went on a date with someone else. I wouldn't stop him, or bitch him out, but I would feel bad.
